# BPMN Desk 0.7.2

- Check for new GitHub releases at startup and every six hours. An amber version badge opens the latest release; installation remains manual.
- Click the gray version badge to check manually. The button animates for at least a second, with the result and last check time in its tooltip. Network errors and timeouts stay in the tooltip without interrupting work.
- Click the application logo to view author and project links, license, version and runtime information.

Linux AppImage, Windows installer/portable and `SHA256SUMS` are available. Windows executables are unsigned; macOS is not available.
